HALLUCINATIONS: None

The memo accurately reflects all key financial terms present in the source document:

- Amendment date (March 25, 2021) ✓
- Borrower name (Crestwood Midstream Partners LP) ✓
- Administrative Agent (Wells Fargo Bank, National Association) ✓
- Original credit agreement date (October 16, 2018) ✓
- Amendment fee (0.05% of Revolving Facility Commitment) ✓
- Distribution capacity ($275.0 million) ✓
- Effectiveness deadline (April 9, 2021) ✓
- Change in Control threshold (35% voting power) ✓

The memo appropriately notes "N/A" for core credit terms (deal size, interest rate, maturity) that are not specified in this amendment document, which only modifies specific provisions of the existing credit agreement. All financial terms and covenant details mentioned in the memo are directly supported by the source document.

ANSWER: YES
MISSING_TERMS: 
- Administrative Agent name (Wells Fargo Bank, National Association) is mentioned but not clearly presented as a key deal term
- Original Credit Agreement date (October 16, 2018) is referenced but not prominently featured
- Specific lender names and composition of the lending syndicate (includes major banks like Bank of America, JPMorgan Chase, Citibank, Barclays, Royal Bank of Canada, etc.)
- Third Amendment Effective Date conditions and timing requirements beyond the April 9, 2021 deadline
- Governing law (New York State) which is material for enforcement
- The underlying revolving facility structure that enables the borrowings for the transaction
